reason: The preregistration considered only KillBoard resetting the transient mDoubleGameSpeed value. Existing native QoL settings remember speed by default. ToggleGameSpeed saves the preferred speed in the profile's separate userdata/qol-settings-ID.txt file; InitializeGameSpeedButton reads that preference for a new or continued board. The browser save adapter restores the complete /saves tree after reload, including that preference file. Actual Continue and continued screenshots already show2x, and no second speed click was made.

dist/loader.js.fact: Restores browser save filesystem before starting the native game

dist/save-storage.js.fact: Capture and restore include the complete /saves tree

scope: A transparent correction of an incorrect browser-test expectation. Existing game behavior was confirmed from frozen source and actual screenshots; no gameplay, saved layout or native acceptance criterion changed.
